entry.title: Ιράν: Η συμφωνία με τις ΗΠΑ δεν έχει οριστικοποιηθεί
entry.summary: Iran signals that a deal with the US is not finalized despite Trump's claims. Per Mehr, approval from competent authorities is required, while the ballistic missile program stays off the agenda.

entry.title: Πολεοδομίες: Το Μαξίμου αποκρούει τις αιτιάσεις περί «γαλάζιου» σκανδάλου
entry.summary: Maximos Mansion is rebutting opposition accusations of a 'New Democracy' urban-planning scandal after the resignations of general secretaries Efthymios Bakoyannis and Giorgos Didaskalou, insisting they left for personal reasons.

entry.title: Τουρκία: Προτεκτοράτο του Ισραήλ η Κύπρος – Επίθεση και για τη διμερή αμυντική συμφωνία με τη Γαλλία
entry.summary: Turkey is escalating its rhetoric against Cyprus, calling it an 'Israeli protectorate' and attacking the Nicosia-Paris defense pact. Turkey's maritime-zones bill may be postponed beyond the autumn.

entry.title: Στ. Παπασταύρου: Στο Χιούστον για την ίδρυση του Κέντρου Ενέργειας Ανατολικής Μεσογείου
entry.summary: The declaration founding the East Med Energy Center (EMEC) was signed in Houston under the 3+1 scheme (Greece, Cyprus, Israel, US). Energy minister Stavros Papastavrou stressed that energy must not be weaponized.

entry.title: Συνταξιοδοτικό σύστημα ανισοτήτων και συντάξεων πολλαπλών ταχυτήτων
entry.summary: The gap is widening between old and new pensions and between private- and public-sector retirees, per the 'Ilios' system data for May 2026. New private-sector pensioners are the biggest losers.

entry.title: East Med Energy Center: Νέο κεφάλαιο στη συνεργασία ΗΠΑ – Ελλάδας στην ανατολική Μεσόγειο
entry.summary: An analysis of the new East Med Energy Center, based at Rice University's Baker Institute, which aims to become the principal mechanism for US-Greece-Cyprus-Israel energy and geopolitical cooperation, fulfilling a provision of the 2019 EastMed Act.

entry.title: Σε τεντωμένο σχοινί κινείται πλέον ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ
entry.summary: SYRIZA is 'walking a tightrope' after deciding to align with Alexis Tsipras, with even majority cadres demanding a 'cleaner line'. Pavlos Polakis has set leader Sokratis Famellos a ten-day deadline to reach a deal.

entry.title: Τι αλλάζει σε δάνεια και καταθέσεις η αύξηση επιτοκίων από την ΕΚΤ
entry.summary: The ECB's first rate hike since 2023 is expected to add roughly €147 million to Greek banks' annual interest income, as the increase is not passed on equally to deposits, widening the loan-deposit spread.

entry.title: Προσχέδιο συμφωνίας με τις ΗΠΑ δημοσίευσε το Ιράν – Τα 14 σημεία του
entry.summary: Iran's Mehr agency published a 14-point draft memorandum of understanding with the US, with extensive political, military and economic arrangements for immediate de-escalation and 60-day talks. It was not confirmed by Washington.

entry.title: Μητσοτάκης: «Εκλογές την άνοιξη του 2027 με φουτεράκι»
entry.summary: PM Mitsotakis told ANT1 that elections will be held in spring 2027, speaking in a relaxed tone that also touched on holidays and the World Cup. The timing signal is the politically significant takeaway.

entry.title: «Βάρα τα να σε φοβούνται» – Οι διάλογοι της συμμορίας που στρατολογούσε ανηλίκους στα σχολεία
entry.summary: Revealing dialogues implicate a drug-trafficking ring that recruited minors — some as young as 12 — in Athens' northern suburbs, selling in parks, playgrounds and even schools.

entry.title: Κυρ. Μητσοτάκης: Η Ελλάδα σε τροχιά σταθερής ανάπτυξης και μεταρρυθμίσεων
entry.summary: On H.R. McMaster's podcast, Mitsotakis presented his government's economic record, arguing Greece has left the crisis behind and entered a path of steady growth, touching on migration, defense and Greek-Turkish relations.

entry.title: Ο Ελον Μασκ γίνεται ο πρώτος τρισεκατομμυριούχος
entry.summary: Elon Musk became history's first trillionaire after SpaceX's record IPO ($75 billion), with his total wealth surpassing $1.1 trillion.

entry.title: Θεωρείο: Το βαθύ κράτος
entry.summary: A Theoreio column on Maximos Mansion's strategy of treating the urban-planning scandal as an 'opportunity' ahead of elections, casting New Democracy as the force confronting the 'deep state'. Mitsotakis also took a swipe at the late Costas Simitis.

entry.title: Η BYD πατάει γκάζι για κυριαρχία στην παγκόσμια αγορά αυτοκινήτου
entry.summary: China's BYD aims to overtake Toyota and become the world's largest carmaker within five years, investing over €2 billion in Europe in ultra-fast charging infrastructure.

entry.title: Ουκρανία: Ζητά επιπλέον 20 δισ. από τους συμμάχους για να διατηρήσει το «πλεονέκτημα» έναντι της Ρωσίας
entry.summary: Ukraine is expected to request an additional $20 billion in military funding from allies in the 'Ramstein Group', citing a 6-9 month 'window of opportunity' on the battlefield against Russia.

entry.title: Ανοιξε ο δρόμος για την αύξηση κεφαλαίου 1 δισ. του ΑΔΜΗΕ
entry.summary: The path opened for IPTO's (ADMIE) €1 billion capital increase after approval by ADMIE Holdings' extraordinary general meeting, which will contribute €510 million via a combined public offering and private placement.

entry.title: Ανδρουλάκης: Προτείνει δωρεάν μετακινήσεις στα μέσα μεταφοράς για νέους έως 24 ετών
entry.summary: PASOK leader Nikos Androulakis pledged universal free public transport for all young people up to age 24 in Attica and Thessaloniki, calling it a measure of social justice for a struggling generation.

entry.title: Διπλασιάστηκαν σε 15 χρόνια τα παγκόσμια χρέη από μικροδάνεια
entry.summary: Global microloan debt has doubled in 15 years, with repayment crises in many countries. Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus's vision of poverty-free microfinance has turned into a vicious cycle of debt for millions.

entry.title: E.E.: Πακέτο στήριξης 540 εκατ. ευρώ για αγρότες λόγω της εκτίναξης των τιμών των λιπασμάτων
entry.summary: The European Commission proposed a €540 million support package for EU farmers due to soaring fertilizer prices stemming from the war with Iran. With national funds it could reach €1.5 billion.
